subtitle: NeoForge 1.21.1 - 5 subpacks

tasks.title: Diagnose the 90% screen flash bang
tasks.note: gh_ray_occlusion.fsh glare reached SunRadius*10 = 0.45 screen-heights; the composite held it at full strength

tasks.title: Diagnose 'rays only at certain angles'
tasks.note: SunRadius was a fixed screen fraction; the sun behind the camera returned early

tasks.title: Replace the vanilla square sun with a realistic one
tasks.note: SunRenderer + LevelRendererSunMixin: round disc, limb darkening, corona, FOV-correct size

tasks.title: Rewrite the god ray pass
tasks.note: Seeds the sun's real disc, off-screen and anti-solar convergence, gentler composite

tasks.title: Underwater light shafts
tasks.note: UnderwaterShaftsRenderer + gh_water_shafts.fsh: refracted sun ray, caustic bands, depth absorption

tasks.title: Flat horizontal ripple rings
tasks.note: WaterRippleParticle overrides render() to build an XZ-plane quad, both windings

tasks.title: Event-driven ripple spawning
tasks.note: WaterImpactHandler: entity/item crosses the surface -> a ring; the ambient spawner is gone

tasks.title: Build the whole project
tasks.note: gradlew build - green

tasks.title: Live test in game
tasks.note: User to confirm: sun, shafts through branches, underwater shafts, impact ripples

tasks.title: Fix 1: the god ray wash (massive light)
tasks.note: The off-screen fallback seeded a BROAD blob; a broad seed blurs to an even field, not to rays

tasks.title: Fix 1: bound the composite
tasks.note: Tone curve is now 1 - exp(-lit), capped at 1.0, so the shafts can never blow out the sky

tasks.title: Fix 2: no god rays at all
tasks.note: Same root cause - the seed is now the sun small disc, which is what produces distinct rays

tasks.title: Fix 3: flashing light patches under water
tasks.note: The caustic clock was in TICKS: the pattern zipped across at 13 blocks/s. Now seconds.

tasks.title: Widen the god ray light source
tasks.note: SEED_ANGLE 4.3 deg so a canopy can cut it into pieces; the drawn sun stays small

tasks.title: 48 blur samples instead of 32
tasks.note: the long reach pass was hitting a 30px source six times - that moire read as parallel streaks

tasks.title: Coarser underwater caustics, 12 samples
tasks.note: a fine pattern was averaged into the flat screen-wide glow

tasks.title: Sun shadow map (orthographic, sun POV)
tasks.note: SunShadowMap: 1024 map over 128 blocks, reuses the compiled chunk buffers

tasks.title: Volumetric raymarch against the map
tasks.note: VolumetricShaftsRenderer: Henyey-Greenstein phase, depth-clipped, half res

tasks.title: Keep the screen-space glow alongside it
tasks.note: the cheap wide halo around the sun

tasks.title: Build the whole project
tasks.note: gradlew build - green

tasks.title: Live test in game
tasks.note: shafts at any angle, underwater shafts, and the frame cost of the shadow pass

tasks.title: God rays followed the head
tasks.note: MC applies the walk-cycle head bob to the PROJECTION matrix, so the sun screen position swung ~15px per step

tasks.title: Rebuild the projection without the bob
tasks.note: SunRenderer.unbobbedProjection: a rotation leaves m11/m00 intact, so fov and aspect survive

tasks.title: Live test in game
tasks.note: check the shafts stay still while walking

tasks.title: Clouds were flashing super fastly
tasks.note: MY BUG: the shadow map pass left the viewport at 1024x1024 and the cloud renderer sets no viewport of its own

tasks.title: Underwater had patches, not rays
tasks.note: the pattern is now RIDGES across the light travel, so each one sweeps a beam down

tasks.title: Less water fog
tasks.note: far plane 14-24 -> 22-38 blocks, tint a little lighter

tasks.title: Clouds cast shadows on the ground
tasks.note: the cloud tiles are drawn into the sun shadow map; a multiply pass darkens what the sun cannot reach

tasks.title: Clouds break the shafts into beams
tasks.note: the gaps now come from the real cloud geometry, not a 48x48 screen map

tasks.title: Live test in game
tasks.note: clouds, ground shadows, beams, underwater rays, fog

tasks.title: Lens rain: refraction through the drops
tasks.note: gh_lens_rain.fsh - the world is sampled through each drop, not sprites over it

tasks.title: Lens rain: the wind decides the character
tasks.note: the wind blowing into the player makes the drops run down; the other way gives small splashes

tasks.title: Lens rain: driven by the body wetness
tasks.note: clear below 50% wet, fewer and smaller as the player dries from 100%

tasks.title: Lens rain: the slush on surfacing
tasks.note: a sheet running off the lens for 2.2s, then it settles into the drops

tasks.title: Live test in game
tasks.note: rain in the wind, and coming out of the water

tasks.title: Clouds drifting while paused
tasks.note: the drift is integrated from the system clock; now gated on Minecraft.isPaused()

tasks.title: Survey every per-frame animation
tasks.note: system clock users found across all five subpacks

tasks.title: New pause-aware GameClock
tasks.note: the same wall clock, but it only advances while the game runs

tasks.title: HUD clocks on the pause-aware clock
tasks.note: kill feed rows, combat timer message, bandage in-hand spin

tasks.title: CelestialLight: the sun or the moon, whichever is up
tasks.note: the moon is the sun direction reversed - vanilla draws both in the same rotated frame

tasks.title: The shadow map follows the light
tasks.note: so the trees block the moonlight too and the shafts come through the canopy at night

tasks.title: Cold silver moon shafts
tasks.note: silver-blue tint, a fraction of the sun strength

tasks.title: A darker night
tasks.note: NightDarkeningRenderer: a fullscreen multiply, run BEFORE the shafts are added

tasks.title: The moon's phase survives
tasks.note: the screen-space pass is daytime only - its hard disc would wash the phase out

tasks.title: The player was not reflected
tasks.note: the march stepped 1.7 blocks at a time and stepped straight over a 0.6 block wide player

tasks.title: The march step now grows with distance
tasks.note: fine near, coarse far - near geometry is what a puddle reflects

tasks.title: The refinement bisected screen space
tasks.note: it mixed the depths of two points at different distances; now it bisects the distance along the ray in world space

tasks.title: The puddle edge was a hard aliased line
tasks.note: the mask is now linearly filtered and its value is the reflection alpha, so it fades over the edge

tasks.title: Looking straight down lost the reflection
tasks.note: pure water is 2% at normal incidence; MIN_REFLECTANCE 0.12 gives the wet-surface sheen
